description: Delete one of your services from your store. Writes to the chain: this prepares an unsigned transaction (an intent) for `signer`; nothing happens until you sign it with geode-local-signer and submit it with geode_submit_intent. Irreversible: the first call returns a confirm_token; call again with it to proceed.

confirm_token.description: Token from the first call, to confirm this irreversible action

signer.description: Your account address (SS58). The transaction is prepared for this account; you sign it on your own machine with geode-local-signer.

name: geode_market_delete_a_service
title: Market: delete a service
